# Northwind University Brand Rulebook

Sample rulebook for testing Plumbline. Upload it in Brand Knowledge, then Rulebooks.

## Rankings and awards

Never describe the university as "number one", "the best" or "top-ranked" unless the exact ranking, the ranking body and the year are stated, for example "Ranked 12th in NIRF 2026 (Engineering)".

Award claims must name the award and the year. Do not say "award-winning faculty" on its own.

## Placements

Placement figures must use the official Training and Placement Cell report. Never promise or guarantee placements, jobs or salaries to applicants. Say "placement support" instead of "guaranteed placement".

## Fees and scholarships

Do not call fees "cheap" or "low cost". Say "affordable fees" and link to the official fee structure. Never write "100% scholarship" or "free education" unless the scholarship name and eligibility are stated.

## Tone on social media

Use a warm, student-first tone. Avoid slang such as "lit", "insane" or "crazy" in official posts. Use at most three hashtags per post and always include #NorthwindU.

## Admissions deadlines

Only quote admission deadlines from the current academic calendar. If a date is not confirmed, say "dates will be announced on the admissions portal" instead of guessing.

## Students and privacy

Do not name or tag students in posts without written consent. Never share student phone numbers, email addresses or marks.
